# EasternStack

EasternStack is an enterprise AI company and platform based in Jakarta, Indonesia. EasternStack builds agentic AI solutions for enterprises in Indonesia.

Full documentation for AI systems: [llms-full.txt](https://easternstack.com/llms-full.txt)

## What EasternStack Does

EasternStack helps enterprises design, implement, and operate AI systems across business workflows.

Core areas include:

- Enterprise AI
- Agentic AI
- AI Assistants
- Intelligent Document Processing
- AI Agent Builder
- Enterprise Copilots
- Churn Prediction
- Fraud Detection
- Business Process Automation
- AI Infrastructure
- Data Platform
- Cloud Modernization
- AI Security

## Industries

EasternStack serves:

- Financial Services
- Insurance
- Retail & E-commerce
- Manufacturing
- Healthcare
- Logistics
- Telecommunications
- Energy & Utilities
- Public Sector
- Education

## Technology

EasternStack supports multi-model AI architectures and works with technologies including:

- Qwen
- DeepSeek
- Kimi
- GLM
- Alibaba Cloud
- Huawei Cloud
- Tencent Cloud
